page.listDescription: Onboard programmes and attach tenant operators.
page.newDescription: Validate meta access with a programme PAT, then create the programme and child tenant. Workspace root is configured on the gateflow host.
page.detailDescription: Programme details and tenant admin operators.
list.empty: No programmes yet. Onboard one to get started.
list.columns.name: Name
fields.name: Name
catalogue.title: Repo catalogue
catalogue.description: Meta-derived candidates from programme onboard or refresh. This is not fleet membership — tenant admins admit repos on Fleet. Wave start remains a separate capability (CAP-C).
catalogue.empty: No catalogue candidates stored for this programme. Refresh after meta is available, or re-onboard.
create.successHint: Programme created. Attach a tenant admin so operators can sign in.
attach.title: Attach tenant admin
attach.description: Creates a login identity bound to this programme’s tenant. They sign in separately on the login page.
attach.successCreated: Tenant admin created. Ask them to sign in with these credentials.
attach.successExisting: Tenant admin already attached (idempotent). They can sign in with existing credentials.
errors.createFailed: Programme create failed. Check meta access, PAT, and that the gateflow host workspace is configured.
errors.catalogueRefreshFailed: Could not refresh the programme catalogue. Check meta access on the gateflow host.
errors.platformAdminRequired: Platform admin role is required for this action.
errors.wrongRole: This area is for platform administrators. Sign in with a platform admin account, or use Tenant and Fleet as a tenant admin.
